from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly.invoice import invoice_total, issue_invoice
from ledgerly.models import Invoice, LineItem, Subscription
from ledgerly.payments import authorize
from ledgerly.subscriptions import current_period

T0 = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def make_invoice():
    return Invoice(
        id="inv_1",
        customer_id="cus_1",
        lines=[LineItem("Seat", 3, Decimal("19.99")), LineItem("Setup", 1, Decimal("50.00"))],
    )


def test_invoice_total():
    assert invoice_total(make_invoice()) == Decimal("109.97")


def test_issue_invoice_records_audit():
    inv = issue_invoice(make_invoice(), T0)
    assert inv.status == "issued"
    assert audit.events("invoice_issued")[0]["invoice_id"] == "inv_1"


def test_issue_empty_invoice_fails():
    with pytest.raises(BillingError):
        issue_invoice(Invoice(id="inv_2", customer_id="cus_1"), T0)


def test_authorize_payment():
    inv = issue_invoice(make_invoice(), T0)
    payment = authorize("pay_1", inv, "109.97", T0)
    assert payment.amount == Decimal("109.97")
    assert payment.status == "authorized"


def test_current_period():
    sub = Subscription("sub_1", "cus_1", Decimal("30.00"), 30, T0)
    start, end = current_period(sub, datetime(2026, 2, 5, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    assert start == datetime(2026, 1, 31, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    assert end == datetime(2026, 3, 2, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

import re
p = "ledgerly/adjustments.py"
s = open(p).read()
old = '''def write_off(invoice, at, reason):
    """Write off an issued invoice that will never be paid."""
    if invoice.status != "issued":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")
    if not reason:
        raise BillingError("reason_required", invoice.id)
    at = ensure_utc(at)
    amount = invoice_total(invoice)
    invoice.status = "void"
    audit.record("invoice_written_off", invoice_id=invoice.id, amount=amount, reason=reason, at=at)
    return {"invoice_id": invoice.id, "amount": amount, "reason": reason}
'''
new = '''def write_off(invoice, at, reason, *, idempotency_key=None):
    """Write off an issued invoice that will never be paid."""
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for entry in audit.events("invoice_written_off"):
            if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                return {
                    "invoice_id": entry["invoice_id"],
                    "amount": entry["amount"],
                    "reason": entry["reason"],
                }
    if invoice.status != "issued":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")
    if not reason:
        raise BillingError("reason_required", invoice.id)
    at = ensure_utc(at)
    amount = invoice_total(invoice)
    invoice.status = "void"
    audit.record(
        "invoice_written_off",
        invoice_id=invoice.id,
        amount=amount,
        reason=reason,
        at=at,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    return {"invoice_id": invoice.id, "amount": amount, "reason": reason}
'''
assert old in s
open(p, "w").write(s.replace(old, new))
EOF
python -m pytest -q"}

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.adjustments import write_off
from ledgerly.models import Invoice, LineItem
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

audit.clear()
inv = Invoice("inv_1", "cus_1", lines=[LineItem("Seat", 1, Decimal("50.00"))], status="issued")
at = datetime(2026, 2, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
r1 = write_off(inv, at, "insolvent", idempotency_key="k1")
r2 = write_off(inv, at, "insolvent", idempotency_key="k1")
assert r1 == r2, (r1, r2)
assert len(audit.events("invoice_written_off")) == 1
assert audit.events("invoice_written_off")[0]["idempotency_key"] == "k1"
# no key still works
inv2 = Invoice("inv_2", "cus_1", lines=[LineItem("Seat", 1, Decimal("10.00"))], status="issued")
assert write_off(inv2, at, "x")["amount"] == Decimal("10.00")
# non-issued rejected
try:
    write_off(inv2, at, "x")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "invalid_state"
print("ok")
EOF"}
